app.name: Localize network faults
app.description: Determine which equipment group or individual node the submitted path reports actually implicate. Compare every permitted failure combination under the declared fault bound, assessed snapshot and reliable path predictor. Separate a stable zone-level finding from individual node failures that remain uncertain before making further diagnostic or repair decisions. The result describes what the record establishes; it does not authorize a repair.
app.source:
# Canonical evidence-review/1 model. Rules and presentation are data.
format: evidence-review/1
module:
  id: network-fault-evidence
  version: "1.3.0"
  title: Localize network faults
  metadata:
    catalog:
      domain:
        id: network-operations
        label: Network operations
        description: Network monitoring and diagnosis from declared topology and test records.
      useCase:
        id: fault-localization
        label: Locate network faults
        description: Determine which fault zones and individual node failures are established by path-test results.
  description: "Determine which equipment group or individual node the submitted path reports actually implicate. Compare every permitted failure combination under the declared fault bound, assessed snapshot and reliable path predictor. Separate a stable zone-level finding from individual node failures that remain uncertain before making further diagnostic or repair decisions. The result describes what the record establishes; it does not authorize a repair."
  question: "Where do the path-test results locate a fault, and which nodes have failed?"
  boundary: "The conclusions cover the submitted node inventory, topology, fixed routes, available probing configuration and assessed snapshot. Monitors are assumed healthy and listed nonmonitor failures persist within that snapshot. A path fails exactly when it contains a failed nonmonitor. Link faults, monitor faults, routing uncertainty, report errors and temporal changes require a different model. Probability measures, global identifiability over every possible record and repair authorization are not established."
  assumptions: [All submitted monitors are healthy throughout the assessed snapshot., "Only listed nonmonitor nodes may fail, persistently within the assessed snapshot.", A path fails exactly when at least one of its listed nonmonitors fails., "The declared maximum number of simultaneous failures is a premise, not a conclusion established by the observations.", Every submitted reliable path report is preserved and must match its predicted state., "Zone membership identifies an equipment grouping; it is not additional evidence that a node failed.", The smallest compatible failure combination is not automatically the established explanation or a repair instruction.]
  parameters:
    - id: maxFaults
      type: integer
      min: 0
      max: 4
      default: 2
      label: Maximum simultaneous node failures
    - id: configuration
      type: string
      default: UP
      label: Available probing configuration
    - id: snapshot
      type: string
      default: S1
      label: Assessed snapshot
    - id: targetZone
      type: string
      default: A
      label: Zone to review
    - id: targetNode
      type: string
      default: v2
      label: Node to review
  relations:
    - id: node
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: monitor
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: node
          type: string
          references:
            relation: node
            column: id
      key: [node]
    - id: zone
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: nonmonitor
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
          references:
            relation: node
            column: id
        - id: zone
          type: string
          references:
            relation: zone
            column: id
      key: [id]
    - id: link
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: from
          type: string
          references:
            relation: node
            column: id
        - id: to
          type: string
          references:
            relation: node
            column: id
      key: [from, to]
    - id: configuration
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: path
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: simplePathConfiguration
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: configuration
          type: string
          references:
            relation: configuration
            column: id
      key: [configuration]
    - id: distinctEndpointConfiguration
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: configuration
          type: string
          references:
            relation: configuration
            column: id
      key: [configuration]
    - id: pathAvailable
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: configuration
          type: string
          references:
            relation: configuration
            column: id
        - id: path
          type: string
          references:
            relation: path
            column: id
      key: [configuration, path]
    - id: routeStep
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: path
          type: string
          references:
            relation: path
            column: id
        - id: index
          type: integer
        - id: from
          type: string
          references:
            relation: node
            column: id
        - id: to
          type: string
          references:
            relation: node
            column: id
      key: [path, index]
    - id: snapshot
      source: basis
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
      key: [id]
    - id: report
      source: evidence
      columns:
        - id: id
          type: string
        - id: path
          type: string
          references:
            relation: path
            column: id
        - id: snapshot
          type: string
          references:
            relation: snapshot
            column: id
        - id: failed
          type: boolean
      key: [id]
      label: Recorded path results
    - id: failed
      source: assignment
      columns:
        - id: node
          type: string
          references:
            relation: nonmonitor
            column: id
      key: [node]
      label: Nodes failed in this possible combination
    - id: pathNonmonitor
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: path
          type: string
        - id: node
          type: string
      key: [path, node]
      label: Nodes tested by each path
    - id: failedPath
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: path
          type: string
      key: [path]
    - id: prediction
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: path
          type: string
        - id: failed
          type: boolean
      key: [path]
      label: Predicted path states
    - id: faultZone
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: zone
          type: string
      key: [zone]
      label: Zones containing a fault
    - id: mismatch
      source: derived
      columns:
        - id: report
          type: string
        - id: path
          type: string
        - id: predicted
          type: boolean
        - id: reported
          type: boolean
      key: [report]
  generation:
    - id: GENERATE.FAULTS
      relation: failed
      from:
        relation: nonmonitor
        column: id
      min: 0
      max:
        parameter: maxFaults
  rules:
    - id: PATH.MEMBER.FROM
      head:
        relation: pathNonmonitor
        args: ["?path", "?node"]
      body:
        - relation: routeStep
          args: ["?path", "?index", "?node", "?next"]
        - relation: nonmonitor
          args: ["?node", "?zone"]
    - id: PATH.MEMBER.TO
      head:
        relation: pathNonmonitor
        args: ["?path", "?node"]
      body:
        - relation: routeStep
          args: ["?path", "?index", "?previous", "?node"]
        - relation: nonmonitor
          args: ["?node", "?zone"]
    - id: PREDICT.FAILURE
      head:
        relation: failedPath
        args: ["?path"]
      body:
        - relation: pathNonmonitor
          args: ["?path", "?node"]
        - relation: failed
          args: ["?node"]
    - id: PREDICT.TRUE
      head:
        relation: prediction
        args: ["?path", true]
      body:
        - relation: path
          args: ["?path"]
        - relation: failedPath
          args: ["?path"]
    - id: PREDICT.FALSE
      head:
        relation: prediction
        args: ["?path", false]
      body:
        - relation: path
          args: ["?path"]
        - not:
            relation: failedPath
            args: ["?path"]
    - id: PROJECT.ZONE
      head:
        relation: faultZone
        args: ["?zone"]
      body:
        - relation: failed
          args: ["?node"]
        - relation: nonmonitor
          args: ["?node", "?zone"]
    - id: REPORT.MISMATCH
      head:
        relation: mismatch
        args: ["?id", "?path", "?predicted", "?reported"]
      body:
        - relation: report
          args: ["?id", "?path", "?snapshot", "?reported"]
        - relation: prediction
          args: ["?path", "?predicted"]
        - op: ne
          args: ["?predicted", "?reported"]
  admission:
    - id: CONFIG.KNOWN
      label: The probing configuration is declared
      when: []
      assert:
        op: exists
        atom:
          relation: configuration
          args:
            - parameter: configuration
    - id: SNAPSHOT.KNOWN
      label: The target snapshot is declared
      when: []
      assert:
        op: exists
        atom:
          relation: snapshot
          args:
            - parameter: snapshot
    - id: ZONE.KNOWN
      label: The target zone is declared
      when: []
      assert:
        op: exists
        atom:
          relation: zone
          args:
            - parameter: targetZone
    - id: NODE.KNOWN
      label: The target node is a nonmonitor
      when:
        - count:
            relation: nonmonitor
            args:
              - parameter: targetNode
              - "?zone"
          as: "?matches"
      assert:
        op: gt
        args: ["?matches", 0]
    - id: REPORT.SNAPSHOT
      label: Every report belongs to the assessed snapshot
      when:
        - relation: report
          args: ["?id", "?path", "?snapshot", "?reported"]
      assert:
        op: eq
        args:
          - "?snapshot"
          - parameter: snapshot
    - id: REPORT.AVAILABLE
      label: Every observed path is available in the declared configuration
      when:
        - relation: report
          args: ["?id", "?path", "?snapshot", "?reported"]
      assert:
        op: exists
        atom:
          relation: pathAvailable
          args:
            - parameter: configuration
            - "?path"
    - id: MONITORS.HEALTHY
      label: A node is not both a monitor and a possible fault
      when:
        - relation: nonmonitor
          args: ["?node", "?zone"]
      assert:
        op: notExists
        atom:
          relation: monitor
          args: ["?node"]
    - id: ROUTE.LINK
      label: Each route step uses a declared undirected link
      when:
        - relation: routeStep
          args: ["?path", "?index", "?from", "?to"]
        - not:
            relation: link
            args: ["?from", "?to"]
        - not:
            relation: link
            args: ["?to", "?from"]
      assert:
        op: eq
        args: [true, false]
    - id: PATH.START
      label: Every path has an initial step
      when:
        - relation: path
          args: ["?path"]
      assert:
        op: exists
        atom:
          relation: routeStep
          args: ["?path", 0, "?from", "?to"]
    - id: ROUTE.INDEX
      label: Step indexes are nonnegative
      when:
        - relation: routeStep
          args: ["?path", "?index", "?from", "?to"]
      assert:
        op: gte
        args: ["?index", 0]
    - id: ROUTE.CONTIGUOUS
      label: Every later step continues its immediate predecessor
      when:
        - relation: routeStep
          args: ["?path", "?index", "?from", "?to"]
        - op: gt
          args: ["?index", 0]
      assert:
        op: exists
        atom:
          relation: routeStep
          args:
            - "?path"
            - subtract: ["?index", 1]
            - "?previousFrom"
            - "?from"
    - id: ROUTE.START.MONITOR
      label: The initial source is a healthy monitor
      when:
        - relation: routeStep
          args: ["?path", 0, "?from", "?to"]
      assert:
        op: exists
        atom:
          relation: monitor
          args: ["?from"]
    - id: ROUTE.END.MONITOR
      label: The terminal target is a healthy monitor
      when:
        - relation: routeStep
          args: ["?path", "?index", "?from", "?to"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: routeStep
            args:
              - "?path"
              - add: ["?index", 1]
              - "?nextFrom"
              - "?nextTo"
      assert:
        op: exists
        atom:
          relation: monitor
          args: ["?to"]
    - id: ROUTE.INTERIOR.NONMONITOR
      label: Interior nodes are possible-fault nonmonitors
      when:
        - relation: routeStep
          args: ["?path", "?index", "?from", "?to"]
        - op: gt
          args: ["?index", 0]
      assert:
        op: exists
        atom:
          relation: nonmonitor
          args: ["?from", "?zone"]
    - id: ROUTE.SIMPLE.INTERIOR
      label: Simple-path configurations do not repeat route source nodes
      when:
        - relation: simplePathConfiguration
          args: ["?configuration"]
        - relation: pathAvailable
          args: ["?configuration", "?path"]
        - relation: routeStep
          args: ["?path", "?first", "?node", "?firstTo"]
        - relation: routeStep
          args: ["?path", "?second", "?node", "?secondTo"]
        - op: lt
          args: ["?first", "?second"]
      assert:
        op: eq
        args: [true, false]
    - id: ROUTE.SIMPLE.TERMINAL
      label: Simple-path configurations do not repeat the terminal node
      when:
        - relation: simplePathConfiguration
          args: ["?configuration"]
        - relation: pathAvailable
          args: ["?configuration", "?path"]
        - relation: routeStep
          args: ["?path", "?index", "?from", "?terminal"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: routeStep
            args:
              - "?path"
              - add: ["?index", 1]
              - "?nextFrom"
              - "?nextTo"
        - relation: routeStep
          args: ["?path", "?earlier", "?terminal", "?earlierTo"]
      assert:
        op: eq
        args: [true, false]
    - id: ROUTE.DISTINCT.ENDPOINTS
      label: Configured paths use distinct endpoints
      when:
        - relation: distinctEndpointConfiguration
          args: ["?configuration"]
        - relation: pathAvailable
          args: ["?configuration", "?path"]
        - relation: routeStep
          args: ["?path", 0, "?source", "?firstTo"]
        - relation: routeStep
          args: ["?path", "?index", "?lastFrom", "?target"]
        - op: notExists
          atom:
            relation: routeStep
            args:
              - "?path"
              - add: ["?index", 1]
              - "?nextFrom"
              - "?nextTo"
      assert:
        op: ne
        args: ["?source", "?target"]
    - id: NODE.PARTITION
      label: Every node is a monitor or a possible-fault nonmonitor
      when:
        - relation: node
          args: ["?node"]
        - not:
            relation: monitor
            args: ["?node"]
      assert:
        op: exists
        atom:
          relation: nonmonitor
          args: ["?node", "?zone"]
  constraints:
    - id: RELIABLE.REPORTS
      label: Every reliable submitted report agrees with its predicted state
      when:
        - relation: report
          args: ["?id", "?path", "?snapshot", "?reported"]
        - relation: prediction
          args: ["?path", "?predicted"]
      assert:
        op: eq
        args: ["?predicted", "?reported"]
  queries:
    - id: target-zone-has-fault
      label: Fault involvement of the selected zone
      kind: boolean
      body:
        - relation: faultZone
          args:
            - parameter: targetZone
    - id: target-node-failed
      label: Failure state of the selected node
      kind: boolean
      body:
        - relation: failed
          args:
            - parameter: targetNode
    - id: exact-failed-set
      label: Complete failed-node combination
      kind: set
      body:
        - relation: failed
          args: ["?node"]
      select: ["?node"]
    - id: v3-failed
      label: Failure state of reference node v3
      kind: boolean
      body:
        - relation: failed
          args: [v3]
    - id: zone-B-has-fault
      label: Fault involvement of reference Zone B
      kind: boolean
      body:
        - relation: faultZone
          args: [B]
  reports:
    tables:
      - id: failed
        label: Nodes that could be failed together
        relation: failed
        columns: [node]
      - id: paths
        label: What this failure combination predicts for each listed path
        relation: prediction
        columns: [path, failed]
      - id: zones
        label: Zones implicated by this failure combination
        relation: faultZone
        columns: [zone]
      - id: members
        label: Nodes tested by each fixed path
        relation: pathNonmonitor
        columns: [path, node]
      - id: mismatch
        label: Reports that disagree with this prediction
        relation: mismatch
        columns: [report, path, predicted, reported]
  presentation:
    description: "Determine whether {{parameter.targetZone}} is implicated by the recorded path results and whether the record also settles the state of {{parameter.targetNode}}. Compare every permitted failure combination before deciding what additional diagnosis is needed."
    question: "Do the test results locate a fault in {{parameter.targetZone}}, and do they identify which nodes failed?"
    labels:
      scenario: Possible failure combination
      scenarios: Possible failure combinations
      assignment: Failed nodes
      answer: Fault finding
      examples: Failure combinations behind these answers
    entities:
      - id: node
        relation: node
        key: id
        template: "node {{row.id}}"
      - id: zone
        relation: zone
        key: id
        template: "Zone {{row.id}}"
      - id: path
        relation: path
        key: id
        template: "path {{row.id}}"
      - id: snapshot
        relation: snapshot
        key: id
        template: "snapshot {{row.id}}"
      - id: configuration
        relation: configuration
        key: id
        template: "{{row.id}} probing configuration"
    columns:
      - relation: monitor
        column: node
        label: Node
        entity: node
      - relation: nonmonitor
        column: zone
        label: Equipment zone
        entity: zone
      - relation: link
        column: from
        label: From node
        entity: node
      - relation: link
        column: to
        label: To node
        entity: node
      - relation: simplePathConfiguration
        column: configuration
        label: Probing configuration
        entity: configuration
      - relation: distinctEndpointConfiguration
        column: configuration
        label: Probing configuration
        entity: configuration
      - relation: pathAvailable
        column: configuration
        label: Probing configuration
        entity: configuration
      - relation: pathAvailable
        column: path
        label: Measurement path
        entity: path
      - relation: routeStep
        column: path
        label: Measurement path
        entity: path
      - relation: routeStep
        column: from
        label: From node
        entity: node
      - relation: routeStep
        column: to
        label: To node
        entity: node
      - relation: report
        column: path
        label: Measurement path
        entity: path
      - relation: report
        column: snapshot
        label: Snapshot
        entity: snapshot
      - relation: report
        column: failed
        label: Recorded result
        values:
          "true": Failed
          "false": Normal
      - relation: failed
        column: node
        label: Node
        entity: node
      - relation: pathNonmonitor
        column: path
        label: Measurement path
        entity: path
      - relation: pathNonmonitor
        column: node
        label: Node
        entity: node
      - relation: failedPath
        column: path
        label: Measurement path
        entity: path
      - relation: prediction
        column: path
        label: Measurement path
        entity: path
      - relation: prediction
        column: failed
        label: Predicted result
        values:
          "true": Failed
          "false": Normal
      - relation: faultZone
        column: zone
        label: Equipment zone
        entity: zone
      - relation: mismatch
        column: path
        label: Measurement path
        entity: path
      - relation: mismatch
        column: predicted
        label: Predicted result
        values:
          "true": Failed
          "false": Normal
      - relation: mismatch
        column: reported
        label: Recorded result
        values:
          "true": Failed
          "false": Normal
    parameters:
      - id: targetZone
        entity: zone
      - id: targetNode
        entity: node
      - id: snapshot
        entity: snapshot
      - id: configuration
        entity: configuration
    queries:
      - id: target-zone-has-fault
        question: "Is there a failed node in {{parameter.targetZone}}?"
        valueLabels:
          "true": Contains a fault
          "false": Contains no fault
        answers:
          establishedTrue: "{{parameter.targetZone}} contains at least one failed node."
          establishedFalse: "{{parameter.targetZone}} contains no failed node under this model."
          underdetermined: "Whether {{parameter.targetZone}} contains a fault remains open."
          inconsistent: The submitted record and assumptions have no compatible explanation.
          incomplete: The current check has not established this answer.
          invalid: These inputs cannot be assessed under this model.
          not-assessed: This question needs an additional assessment contract.
        explanations:
          establishedTrue: "Every failure combination that matches the reports includes a failed node in {{parameter.targetZone}}. Individual node failures may still differ between compatible combinations."
          establishedFalse: "No compatible failure combination includes a failed node in {{parameter.targetZone}}. This finding depends on the submitted routes, reliable-report assumption and fault bound."
          underdetermined: "Some compatible failure combinations implicate {{parameter.targetZone}} and others do not. The current record does not settle zone involvement."
          inconsistent: "No allowed failure combination predicts every submitted report. Review the record and its assumptions together; the conflict does not identify which report or premise is wrong."
          incomplete: The declared combinations have not all been checked. Agreement among discovered combinations is not enough to establish zone involvement.
      - id: target-node-failed
        question: "Has {{parameter.targetNode}} failed?"
        valueLabels:
          "true": Failed
          "false": Normal
        answers:
          establishedTrue: "{{parameter.targetNode}} is failed under the submitted model."
          establishedFalse: "{{parameter.targetNode}} is normal under the submitted model."
          underdetermined: "Whether {{parameter.targetNode}} failed remains open."
          inconsistent: The submitted record and assumptions have no compatible explanation.
          incomplete: The current check has not established this answer.
          invalid: These inputs cannot be assessed under this model.
          not-assessed: This question needs an additional assessment contract.
        explanations:
          establishedTrue: "Every compatible failure combination includes {{parameter.targetNode}}. This conclusion describes the record under the declared assumptions; it is not a repair authorization."
          establishedFalse: "No compatible failure combination includes {{parameter.targetNode}}. This finding covers the assessed snapshot and declared failure model."
          underdetermined: "The opposing combinations below disagree about {{parameter.targetNode}}. Selecting the smaller combination would add a preference, not establish that the selected explanation is true."
          inconsistent: The submitted reports and failure assumptions admit no compatible combination.
          incomplete: The current check has not ruled out every permitted different node answer.
      - id: exact-failed-set
        question: "Which nodes have failed?"
        entity: node
        answers:
          established: "Established failed-node combination: {{answer}}."
          underdetermined: The exact failed-node combination remains open.
          inconsistent: No permitted failure combination matches the record.
          incomplete: The complete failed-node combination has not been established.
        explanations:
          underdetermined: Several different combinations predict the same submitted reports. A zone finding can hold across all of them without settling the individual failures.
      - id: v3-failed
        question: "Has node v3 failed?"
        valueLabels:
          "true": Failed
          "false": Normal
        answers:
          establishedTrue: node v3 is failed under the submitted model.
          establishedFalse: node v3 is normal under the submitted model.
          underdetermined: Whether node v3 failed remains open.
          inconsistent: The submitted record and assumptions have no compatible explanation.
          incomplete: The current check has not established this answer.
          invalid: These inputs cannot be assessed under this model.
          not-assessed: This question needs an additional assessment contract.
        explanations:
          establishedTrue: "Every compatible failure combination includes node v3. This conclusion describes the record under the declared assumptions; it is not a repair authorization."
          establishedFalse: No compatible failure combination includes node v3. This finding covers the assessed snapshot and declared failure model.
          underdetermined: "The opposing combinations below disagree about node v3. Selecting the smaller combination would add a preference, not establish that the selected explanation is true."
          inconsistent: The submitted reports and failure assumptions admit no compatible combination.
          incomplete: The current check has not ruled out every permitted different node answer.
      - id: zone-B-has-fault
        question: "Is there a failed node in Zone B?"
        valueLabels:
          "true": Contains a fault
          "false": Contains no fault
        answers:
          establishedTrue: Zone B contains at least one failed node.
          establishedFalse: Zone B contains no failed node under this model.
          underdetermined: Whether Zone B contains a fault remains open.
          inconsistent: The submitted record and assumptions have no compatible explanation.
          incomplete: The current check has not established this answer.
          invalid: These inputs cannot be assessed under this model.
          not-assessed: This question needs an additional assessment contract.
        explanations:
          establishedTrue: Every failure combination that matches the reports includes a failed node in Zone B. Individual node failures may still differ between compatible combinations.
          establishedFalse: "No compatible failure combination includes a failed node in Zone B. This finding depends on the submitted routes, reliable-report assumption and fault bound."
          underdetermined: Some compatible failure combinations implicate Zone B and others do not. The current record does not settle zone involvement.
          inconsistent: "No allowed failure combination predicts every submitted report. Review the record and its assumptions together; the conflict does not identify which report or premise is wrong."
          incomplete: The declared combinations have not all been checked. Agreement among discovered combinations is not enough to establish zone involvement.
    reports:
      answer:
        title: Fault finding
        question: "Do the results locate a fault in {{parameter.targetZone}}, and has {{parameter.targetNode}} failed?"
        description: Separate a stable equipment-group finding from node states that remain uncertain.
      interpretations:
        title: Possible failure combinations
        question: "Which failure combinations fit all recorded path results?"
        description: Inspect every compatible combination. A smaller combination is not automatically the true explanation.
      stability:
        title: Why the finding holds
        question: "Could another compatible failure combination change the answer?"
        description: Compare concrete combinations supporting or challenging each zone or node finding.
      findings:
        title: Conflicts and input checks
        question: "Which failure combinations were ruled out, and does the submitted information need attention?"
        description: Review input applicability and the constraints that exclude proposed combinations.
      basis:
        title: Scope and assumptions
        question: "Which topology, paths, snapshot and failure assumptions support this finding?"
        description: Inspect the evaluated case and its limits before using the result for further diagnostic work.
      changes:
        title: Effect of case changes
        question: "How did new reports, a different fault bound or a changed target affect the finding?"
        description: Compare recomputed findings while preserving the exact basis of earlier calculations.
    tableGroups:
      - id: possible-faults
        title: Faults in this possible combination

definitionContract.title: Establish the required answer
definitionContract.responsibility: Generate interpretations from declared finite rules, retain evidence-compatible alternatives, and test stability of the required answer.
invariants: Establishment requires a nonempty admissible basis and a completed counterexample check.
Different admissible answers demonstrate underdetermination even before enumeration completes.
An empty interrupted search does not establish inconsistency.
A Boolean false answer can be established. Counts do not imply probabilities.
Results are relative to the authored finite model, submitted evidence and exact query.

module.title: Localize network faults

domain.label: Network operations
domain.description: Network monitoring and diagnosis from declared topology and test records.

useCase.label: Locate network faults
useCase.description: Determine which fault zones and individual node failures are established by path-test results.

module.description: Determine which equipment group or individual node the submitted path reports actually implicate. Compare every permitted failure combination under the declared fault bound, assessed snapshot and reliable path predictor. Separate a stable zone-level finding from individual node failures that remain uncertain before making further diagnostic or repair decisions. The result describes what the record establishes; it does not authorize a repair.
module.question: Where do the path-test results locate a fault, and which nodes have failed?
module.boundary: The conclusions cover the submitted node inventory, topology, fixed routes, available probing configuration and assessed snapshot. Monitors are assumed healthy and listed nonmonitor failures persist within that snapshot. A path fails exactly when it contains a failed nonmonitor. Link faults, monitor faults, routing uncertainty, report errors and temporal changes require a different model. Probability measures, global identifiability over every possible record and repair authorization are not established.
assumptions: All submitted monitors are healthy throughout the assessed snapshot.
Only listed nonmonitor nodes may fail, persistently within the assessed snapshot.
A path fails exactly when at least one of its listed nonmonitors fails.
The declared maximum number of simultaneous failures is a premise, not a conclusion established by the observations.
Every submitted reliable path report is preserved and must match its predicted state.
Zone membership identifies an equipment grouping; it is not additional evidence that a node failed.
The smallest compatible failure combination is not automatically the established explanation or a repair instruction.

answers.establishedTrue: {{parameter.targetZone}} contains at least one failed node.
answers.establishedFalse: {{parameter.targetZone}} contains no failed node under this model.

answers.inconsistent: The submitted record and assumptions have no compatible explanation.

explanations.establishedTrue: Every failure combination that matches the reports includes a failed node in {{parameter.targetZone}}. Individual node failures may still differ between compatible combinations.
